offence_note: Robbery, obtaining credit by false pretences, imitation firearm use, breach of probation
sentence_quote: allow the appeal to the extent that the 42-month sentence for the robbery shall be reduced by a total of 505 days, to two years and 42 days after allowing for credit calculated on the basis of 1:1.5
note: Appeal only about pre-sentence credit; 42 months robbery plus 12 months consecutive; credit raised to 1:1.5.

offence_note: Possession for trafficking of several drugs; simple possession of buprenorphine
sentence_quote: The appellant was sentenced to an aggregate sentence of three years.
note: Conviction appeal dismissed; leave to appeal sentence granted, sentence appeal dismissed.

offence_note: Assault, assault with weapon, uttering threats against intimate partner
sentence_quote: a sentence of 20 months in custody with 24 months probation is a fit and proper sentence.
note: African Nova Scotian offender, IRCA considered but judge not satisfied it reduced blameworthiness; counts 8m + 12m consecutive.

offence_note: Break and enter, assault with weapon, attempted kidnapping
note: Crown appeal: court finds offender dangerous; sentence argument adjourned, no final sentence fixed.

offence_note: Rape and indecent assault of two young teenage girls in 1979
sentence_quote: The trial judge imposed a total sentence of 4 years.
note: Conviction for third complainant stayed (s. 11(b)); 21-month concurrent sentence there not counted.

offence_note: Multiple firearms possession offences while under prohibition
sentence_quote: A conditional sentence order of two years less a day consisting of house arrest for the first 12 months
note: Victim surcharge $2,000 total excluded from fine.

offence_note: Sexual assault, aggravated assault, assault with weapon, unlawful confinement of four women
sentence_quote: I sentence the accused to a further sentence of five years. Considering the time he has already spent in pretrial custody, this translates to an effective sentence of nine years.
note: Two years pretrial custody credited at 2:1 (four years); addiction held neither aggravating nor mitigating.

offence_note: Marihuana production and fraudulently consuming electricity
sentence_quote: we impose a sentence of 18 months and order that execution of that sentence be stayed.
note: Replaces 90-day intermittent sentence; execution of 18 months stayed because 90 days already served.

offence_note: High-level drug trafficking, firearms, threatening, conspiracy to export
sentence_quote: The appellant received an effective 15 year sentence for 2 separate sets of serious charges arising from his prolonged high level drug trafficking enterprise.
note: Two sentencings combined to effective 15 years; appeals dismissed.

offence_note: Assault causing bodily harm, threatening, sexual assault, confinement of girlfriend
sentence_quote: I am sentencing Mr. Morin to five years' imprisonment for all the counts on which he was convicted, all concurrent to each other, less credit for the time he has already served.
systemic_quote: The Gladue report and the other two reports paint a tragic picture of Mr. Morin's life. He has never had a chance from the time of his birth
note: Credit 681 days at time and a half; Gladue weight limited by seriousness.

offence_note: Robbery of store owner; assault with weapon stayed
sentence_quote: He was sentenced to 5 years and 6 months for the robbery charge.

offence_note: Second-degree murder of 82-year-old woman during break-in
sentence_quote: I would dismiss the appeal of the sentencing judge’s decision to impose a sentence of life in prison without eligibility for parole for 15 years and 9 months.
note: 18-year ineligibility reduced by 27 months for segregation and lockdowns; Gladue treatment not fully shown.
